title: It's OVER for Hollywood as We Know It.
text: It's OVER for Hollywood as We Know It.Hollywood is TERRIFIED of the Netflix and Warner Bros. merger, and they've even started a site to try and block the merger. Speaking of which, Paramount is trying everything they can to stop it themselves. Grab popcorn. This showdown will be better than most of the movies being released these days...
